This document appears to be a **permit set / accessibility reference sheet** rather than a narrative report or contract. It is labeled **“ACCESSIBILITY SHEET NO G002”** and includes a dense collection of **code-compliance diagrams, dimensions, and notes** for accessible design. The sheet is associated with the **EXOL Morrisville Phase 1** project at **2300 S Pennsylvania Avenue, Morrisville, PA 19067**, with a project number of **2026-019** and a date of **4/29/2026**. It also identifies the design team and consultants, including Alleato Group, JPS Consulting Engineers, and other engineering disciplines.

This opening block contains drafting/checking fields and consultant contact information for the project team. It lists the design-builder and engineering disciplines with addresses, phone numbers, and web references.
This short administrative section identifies the document as a permit set and provides the date. It also includes sheet revision markings and a partially legible registered architect stamp/name.

This section is a dense set of accessibility standard figure labels and related door, reach, and ramp diagrams. It includes references to maneuvering clearances, turning spaces, door approaches, sliding/folding doors, and ramp landings/edge protection.

This block shifts to general site and building element requirements, including curb ramps, parking spaces, loading zones, and related dimensional standards. It also includes plan-view dimension callouts and references to children's dimensions in ANSI A117.1.
